island.title: Starfall Observatory
island.rule: Nothing flies straight or stands still. Gravity wells bend shots and throws, star bells turn whole rooms in quarter turns, and lit stars form solid ground.
island.feel: Clockmaker wonder meets trick shot billiards over a dark starfield, with crisp brass clicks and curved shots.
island.arc: Learn curved shots on the landing, master orbiting throws in the Meteor Vault and turning star skies in the Planetarium, survive the falling dome, earn the True Lens inside the Grand Orrery, and beat the Astronomer.
moments: Your first bolt bends sharply around a stone pier through a floating gravity well to hit a hidden switch.
Orbiting your lantern in one well while curving one bolt through three wells and a mirror to unlock the vault key.
Standing on one tiny star while ringing a bell so the whole room turns a locked vault straight to your feet.
Midway through the falling dome, orbiting your lantern to bridge around tumbling debris and zipping across open sky.
Standing in a pitch black dome, pulsing the True Lens to glimpse invisible stars, and turning an unseen sky beneath you.

meteor_vault.promise: A trick shot vault where gravity wells bend bolts, meteors, and thrown lanterns around solid shields and chasms.
meteor_vault.power: Apogee Clasp lets thrown lanterns lock into steady orbits around gravity wells.
meteor_vault.arc: Starts with clean curved shots around stone baffles, introduces push and pull flips with meteors, grants orbiting lantern throws, and peaks in a multi-well catapult puzzle and moving moon wells.
meteor_vault.boss: The Twin Moons orbit as opposite wells, testing curved shots and meteors through moving pull and push fields.

planetarium.promise: A dark celestial dome where you build your own star bridges and rotate entire chambers in quarter turns.
planetarium.power: Starlight Sextant turns a thrown lantern into a star anchor and reverses bells.
planetarium.arc: Introduces four-star capped bridges and quarter-turn rooms, teaches lantern star bridging, weaves in blue mirrors and cover bells, and peaks by spinning the room around a lone star perch.
planetarium.boss: The Zodiac shifts across four star shapes as the dome turns, testing star footing, lantern anchors, and curves.

fall.promise: A breathless mid-air descent through tumbling observatory debris right after the dome chains snap.
fall.arc: Opens with crumbling arches and chain anchors, adds curved shots over drifting slabs, fuses orbiting lanterns with star bridging in mid-drop, and ends on the plummeting roof.
fall.boss: The Counterweight hammers the falling roof, testing curved shots around its center gravity well to snap its chains.

orrery.promise: A grand clockwork dome that unites gravity curves, turning star rings, blue optics, and hidden paths seen only with the True Lens.
orrery.power: True Lens pulses reveal invisible platforms, hidden stars, and cloaked foes.
orrery.arc: Builds from classic chasms and blue mirrors to the True Lens shrine, then opens into invisible star domes, nested turning rings, a quiet telescope room, and a three-star bridge to the crown.
orrery.boss: The Astronomer tests True Lens decoy shatters, safe star footing on a turning floor, and twin orbiting wells.

overworld.promise: Explore the observatory grounds, bend your first bolt around stone through a gravity well, and rotate the plaza bridges to reach every wing.
overworld.aha: The central star bell visibly rotates the island walkways in quarter turns to connect different wings.
checks: Did your first curved shot around the landing well feel surprising and clear?
Could you see the plaza star bell rotate the walkways across the island?
Did the sealed observatory dome and side paths pull you toward the beacons?

ow_dome_causeway.promise: Cross a turning causeway above the Planetarium, visit South Camp, and rotate the bridge to uncover a hidden tablet and moth.
ow_dome_causeway.aha: Ringing the causeway bell opens side stairs to the tablet and moth before you bridge south on stars.
checks: Did turning the causeway clearly reveal the stairs to the tablet and moth?
Was lighting the star bridge south intuitive right before the Planetarium?
Did the camp and side trial entrance feel easy to spot and return to?

ow_meteor_apron.promise: Traverse fractured asteroid ledges approaching the Meteor Vault, curving a shot for a tablet and bridging stars to a moth islet.
ow_meteor_apron.aha: Each side reward uses a quick taste of curved shots or star bridging right on the open ledge.
checks: Did the curved shot around the rock fin open the tablet bridge cleanly?
Were the hound and meteor carrier readable across the broken ledges?
Did the paths to the Meteor Vault, trial, and cliff read clearly?

checks: Did the Dream Telescope gate and superboss rift feel distinct and inviting?
Did you spot the cracked pillar hiding the tablet without hunting blindly?
Did crossing the short star bridge over the void feel tense and rewarding?

cave_astrolabe_crypt.promise: Use the True Lens in a dark rift vault to cross invisible stepping stones, uncloak a gravity well and phantom owl, and claim two rewards.
cave_astrolabe_crypt.aha: One lens pulse reveals the floor, the hidden gravity well, and the phantom owl all at once.
checks: Did pulsing the True Lens clearly show the phantom stones and hidden well?
Was fighting the uncloaked owl and shot-eating moth fair in the tight vault?
Did winning both the moth and ember piece feel worth returning with the lens?

cave_broken_pendulum.aha: Flipping the gravity well to push lets you smash the jammed gear tooth so the central turntable can move.
checks: Was it obvious why the central turntable was jammed at first glance?
Did breaking the gear tooth and hitting the eye free the rotor smoothly?
Did ringing the star bell line up the north bridge to the brass lens cleanly?

cave_gravity_well.aha: Aiming just past the rim of a gravity well bends bolts smoothly around walls straight shots cannot pass.
checks: Did the first bend teach the aim offset needed for the tighter second bend?
Could you read where the bolt would curve without guessing blindly?
Did the moth and treasure feel like a good payoff for a short skill cave?

checks: Did the four-star bridge across the pool flow cleanly into the mirror puzzle?
Did rotating the blue mirror into the blue switch feel crisp and fair?
Did hiding your lantern behind a pillar to pass the shadow gate click?

trial_comet_range.promise: Stand behind a brass grate and curve shots through twin gravity wells around three walls to hit all three shielded targets.
trial_comet_range.aha: Each shielded switch asks for a different entry angle past the same pair of gravity wells.

Did each target feel like a fresh angle rather than repeating the same shot?

checks: Did the fading warning on the oldest star give you enough time to step off?
Did the two floating eyes add tension without causing cheap void falls?
Did ringing the finish bell for the ember piece feel tight and exciting?

Did curving shots into the shot-eating moths feel reliable and sharp?
Did earning the extra lead slot and cliff shortcut feel like a big milestone?

Did the sealed lens shutter clearly signal you need the True Lens to go on?

dream_r5.promise: Pulse the True Lens to cross invisible spans, expose two phantom owls around a gravity well, and uncover hidden stars to a lost moth.

dream_r6.promise: Survive a two-wave peak gauntlet combining Island 5 foes around dual gravity wells and a central star bell for the final trophy.

Did the difficulty feel right for the final climb to the star crown?

planet_r1.promise: Arrive in the dark Planetarium dome, light two stars to step onto the center turntable, and ring the bell to swing the west bridge in.

Did the optional counterclockwise blue bell turn to the moth feel clever?
Did the new power feel like it opened fresh ways to cross empty space?

planet_r6.promise: Duel the Meridian Weaver across an eight-star compass ring while it snuffs stars underfoot, ringing corner bells to turn and stun it.
planet_r6.aha: Ringing a corner star bell during the Weaver's slice windup rotates the dome and stuns it open.

planet_r8.promise: Clear two floating eyes, a star jelly, and a shot-eating moth around a gravity well and star bell that rotates eclipse cover walls.

Did swinging the boss key vault right to your feet deliver a strong aha?

planet_r10.promise: Clear a meteor carrier and floating eye, then light four side constellation bays that preview the Zodiac's four forms before the boss.

Did this room feel like the centerpiece payoff of both minor dungeons?

Did locking the Grand Orrery dome into place feel like a big turning point?

orrery_r3.aha: Curve bolts through the center well to bypass front shields while piers block the moth's dashes.
checks: Did the center well let you flank both shielded foes without feeling cramped?

Did this room set a crisp combat bar for the Grand Orrery?

orrery_r4.promise: Unlock the optics gallery and align two blue mirrors to hit twin blue switches, raid a portal cache, and branch toward the carousel.

Did claiming the Keeper's Flame and unlocking the boss door feel momentous?
